issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the worker of the position paper-repo of the research world rw_c7307a00205b, given to you to read (it is finished; its checkpoints include its final one). Its task was a one-paragraph report on how fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa rose over the last ten years, from NOAA's annual means downloaded during the work. The incumbent worker of every position there is Codex with gpt-6.1-sol at low reasoning effort.

Candidates may use only Codex with gpt-6.1-sol, the agent and model the target world runs; what may change is its native settings, such as its effort or its environment. Take the tasks from the target world; no judging is given, so propose it.

Keep it small: one candidate, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept worker back by continuing rw_c7307a00205b from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round. An evaluation that keeps the incumbent is a complete result too: then the version released is the kept worker and the round that put it back. Nothing is published outside this world.
issue.title: Improvement objective
